items.text: VTX-P0-V4A revision built from exact P0-V3. Implemented geometry: two-level inner/outer annular structural rings at radii1.22m and1.75m; levels z0.75 and1.14m. Deep rotor triangles: 8 primary braces from lower R1.75 frame toward four original tilt pivot mounts at R2.6; 8 upper ties and additional shear braces. Four original fuel-cell object IDs preserved and relocated to azimuth45/135/225/315deg, R1.48m z0.83m, tangential-axis orientation. P07 tank inner R0.18m x L0.48m; four nominal gross195.43L and ASSUMED usable166.12L based on 85% fraction; no fuel qualification. 8 protected saddle hoops, isolated liners and frame-mounted triangulated suspension. Removed obsolete P10 two skids; added six independent landing contact pads at R1.90m with stroke-target0.25m, shock body/piston and dual shear load supports. Four local reduction gearbox envelopes are proposals, not assembled tested gears. Preserved all 11 P01-P11 root IDs and 4 original tank IDs. Motion animation retained as viewer clip0 16sec; tested 0,6,9,15.5s. New preliminary target mass ledger kg [132,163,91,88,35,128,48,28,27,42,61]=843kg empty;1073kg with170 crew+60 fuel;1123kg with110 fuel. Wolfram conditional ideal hover239.57kW at1073kg,256.51kW full; short benchmark mission~31.71kg fuel; mean 3m/s 0.25m touchdown load31.23kN full fuel, two-contact mean15.62kN/contact. These are only screening calculations. Known open requirements: actual tube wall/laminate, joints and nonlinear FEA, limit/ultimate landing peak load, modal/vibration, nacelle gyro/inertia/actuation torque, swept tilt and tank restraint clearance, usable fuel bladder/capacity, gear and CV continuous duty, closed-loop flight control and test safety. No new airworthiness acceptance or certification.

P0-V3 flight-motion and vectoring study, saved version version_dd12279b59abee9e412e34012e973a85dbd8825da4e49fe5b6b462562357aa6d. Inspectable 16s animation: lift, forward translation, turning/banking, deceleration, rotor spin and thrust-vector changes; replaced exploded animation. Four elevated 2-axis tilt hubs, static ±20deg tilt concept with continuous 360deg horizontal thrust direction; rotating shafts do NOT have 360deg structural bend. Geometry includes dual-CV joint envelopes, angular rotor-support trusses, 8 tank saddles plus triangular restraints and protective rails, short-dash yoke, FCC and IMU installation envelopes, signal/power paths and illustrative wakes (not CFD). Model allocated target mass 788kg empty, 1018kg test takeoff and 1068kg full fuel. Wolfram: hover 221.386kW at1018kg, each rotor shaft ~660.65Nm at800rpm hover and1213.69Nm in ideal1.5g screen; tilt actuator sizing reference 4622N at1100Nm assumed hinge moment. Chosen provisional comfort target 0.15g lateral: 8.53deg coordinated bank, 524m radius at100km/h; at200m radius reduce to~61.8km/h. Avionics candidate Embention Veronte 4x and Safran STIM300 RS422 require verified interface conversion; actuator candidate Moog aerospace EMA. This is animated conceptual hardware, NOT demonstrated functional controls, transmission, structural margins, turbine-out survival or certified flightworthiness. Verify rotor swept clearance under loads, CV rating, actuator control, CG, 6DOF simulation, aero, FEA and physical tests. No human acceptance.

VTX P0-V2 Issue C, CURRENT geometry baseline derived from P0-V1 Issue A. Actual editable mesh changes: 16 rotor blade tips at radius1.128379m, nominal total disk area16.0m2, 12mm nominal static blade-to-duct gap; 4 P07 physically hollow fuel-shell meshes each inside radius170mm/inside length460mm, exterior radius173mm/exterior length466mm (nominal 3mm CFRP skin), and 8 fitted strap meshes with connected pickups. Wolfram geometric inner gross total167.057L, assumed usable141.999L after10% ullage and5% unusable allowance; 110kg JetA1 requires137.5L at density0.8kg/L. Modeled shell mass13.128kg assuming uniform density1600kg/m3; no load or fuel qualification. P06 structural ring hollow cross-section R1.19m, tube outer radius45mm inner31mm, theoretical CFRP mass39.989kg; added triangulated load braces; P03 turbine coupling, bearings, four vertical outlets; P02 visible collective pitch linkages. Updated target allocations P03=75kg, P06=84kg, P07=37kg; 11-subsystem empty target691kg, loaded test921kg with170kg passengers+60kg fuel, full971kg with110kg fuel. Previous P0-V1 remains separate immutable version. Wolfram low-order conditional hover190.51kW at921kg, modeled mission fuel25.88kg over27km. All physical strength, composites, thermal, blade aero, speed/torque, gimbal kinematics, fuel integrity and single-engine/rotor-out failure modes remain unverified. Geometry viewer and source saved with assembled/exploded animation.

VTX-P0-V1 / Issue A — source-of-truth register. Design baseline: Technical Performance PDF and Parts Cost/R&D PDF; 671 kg empty is a target allocation, not weighed hardware. All engineering dimensions/calculations are conceptual until physical testing. The 11 P01–P11 subsystem reference records VTX_P01_LINKED through VTX_P11_LINKED are anchored to the saved assembly objects; additional subcomponent references exist for P02 F1, P04 and P06. AUTHORITATIVE EXTERNAL SOURCE METADATA: prefer six CANONICAL_ records (CANONICAL_AKTURK_TIP, CANONICAL_HINE_LIFTFAN, CANONICAL_HU_WEIGHT, CANONICAL_CRITCHFIELD_MDO, CANONICAL_MUNIRAJ_HONEYCOMB, CANONICAL_LIU_COMPOSITES). They carry verified publisher, DOI, year and explicit model-part anchors, and supersede the older VTX_P02_PAPER_*/VTX_SCI_* records that incorrectly use 'VTX P0-V1 engineering study' as an external paper publisher. Older records are retained as immutable history, not source updates. Blendstra mobile shows five recent references, earlier entries remain in note history. The rendered blades have 38.379 mm nominal static tip clearance and 15.26065 m2 actual swept area versus nominal 16 m2; modeled P07 tanks have gross 83.24 L versus 137.5 L needed for 110 kg fuel. Neither defect is resolved by reference metadata. No flightworthiness, vendor certification or human acceptance has been granted.
